ui.hero.title: One platform for every animal in your care
ui.hero.sub: Records, daily operations, and teamwork across all your locations. Find every task in Antz, complete with the real screens.
ui.modules.lede: Tap any card to open its guide, complete with every feature and its screens.
ui.cta.text: Every module has its features and real screens in this guide. Continue from where you last left off, or ask us and we will help.
ui.day.title: What your first day at Antz is like
ui.day.2: Get to know the layout of the app
ui.day.4: Give the right access to each person
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles that fit your organization and activate permissions per module, so that each person sees what their job needs.
ui.faq.q2: Can it be used on phones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The mobile app covers work in the field, such as notes, treatment, transfers, and egg records. The web app covers work at the desk, such as the hospital system, setting up the rearing room (nursery), reports, and pharmacy stock. Updates appear in real-time on phone, tablet, and desktop.
ui.faq.q3: Can we set who can see what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is role-based. You create the roles your organization uses, for example Zoologist, then activate permissions per module.
ui.faq.q4: We manage more than one location. Is that supported?
ui.faq.a4: Antz stores data from every location and department in one place. Animal placement is organized by location, section, and enclosure, and transfers between locations go through approval and exit checks by security officers.
ui.faq.a5: Start with the Getting Started guide, then open the modules that your role uses. If anything is unclear, send an email to hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Necropsy
m.necropsy.intro: The Necropsy module documents post-death examination with detailed observations, per-organ findings, and medical conclusions. This module supports accurate analysis of the cause of death, standardizes reporting, ensures timely handling of the carcass, and meets legal, audit, and veterinary standards.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search & filter
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; filter by location, date, priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Monitor the stages of transfer: Incoming, Delayed, Draft, and Completed.
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card & request info
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID, species, location, cause, requester, priority.
m.deworming.title: Giving Worm Medicine
m.deworming.intro: The Giving Worm Medicine module supports systematic recording and monitoring of parasite-control treatment, ensuring timely administration, correct documentation, and clear tracking of every worm-medicine activity for each animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: Status-based view
m.deworming.f1.desc: Worm-medicine administrations are grouped into Coming Up, Delayed, Skipped, and Completed for easy monitoring.
m.deworming.f2.title: Management of worm-medicine administration
m.deworming.f2.desc: Schedule a series of treatments or directly record medicine that has been given, with the specified dates and details.
m.deworming.f3.title: Administration recording
m.deworming.f3.desc: Records dose, batch number, route of administration, notes, and optional follow-up.
m.housing.title: Placement
m.housing.intro: The Placement module arranges animal habitats across your locations, sections, and enclosures, so that every animal has a known place and every change is recorded. Access at each level is permission-based.
m.housing.f1.title: Location administration
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or edit locations with role-based permissions for safe and structured access.
m.housing.f2.title: Section administration
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or edit sections inside the zoo, with permission-based controls for safe administration.
m.housing.f3.title: Enclosure administration
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or edit enclosures and monitor each one for efficient animal supervision and data.
m.fetal-death.title: Fetal Death
m.fetal-death.intro: The Fetal Death module records and manages fetal death incidents inside enclosures, covering the cause, time, and related animal details. This module supports veterinary care, reproductive health monitoring, trend analysis, and better population management.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Add fetal death record
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Record new incidents, cause, time, parent, animal info.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search & filter
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; filter by location, date, stillborn or miscarriage, species, or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: View death record
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Full details, number of days since death, cause, ID, enclosure, location, sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg Management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The Egg module tracks the whole life cycle of eggs, from laying to hatching or transfer to the rearing room (nursery), ensuring accurate records, real-time updates, and full traceability for better coordination and accountability among the nest, nursery, and hatching teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg dashboard
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Live count: in nests, moved to nursery, marked for disposal.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Egg entry (nest / nursery)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs with parent, condition, date, species, notes, attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight, and the complete Egg Journey Timeline.
m.administer-medicine.title: Giving Medicine
m.administer-medicine.intro: The Giving Medicine module complements the Medical Record by translating prescriptions into executable treatment workflows, enabling real-time delivery of care to individual animals or batches, in the field or in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administration record for the selected date without writing a full medical record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search & filter
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Find records quickly and narrow the list by date, entity, Species, Controlled Substance.
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatments by date in four tabs: Delayed, Given, Skipped, Stopped.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The Vaccination module manages the whole animal vaccination cycle, from scheduling and direct administration to tracking vaccinations that are upcoming, delayed, skipped, and completed. This module ensures timely treatment, accurate dose recording, and full traceability for disease prevention and clinical compliance.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Status-based view
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccinations are grouped into Coming Up, Delayed, Skipped, and Completed for easy monitoring.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Vaccination management
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Schedule vaccinations or directly record vaccines that have been given, with the specified dates and medicine details.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Administration recording
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Records dose, batch number, route of administration, notes, and optional follow-up.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Enables fast, accurate, and traceable handing over of medical products directly to authorized doctors, ensuring timely fulfillment and automatic inventory updates from prescription to shelf, with batch-level visibility and expiry tracking throughout the process.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Dashboard
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Real-time insights into stock problems, shipments, purchases, requests, usage, expiry, and fast-selling products, with visual trends for quick action.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search & filter
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Quickly find records by Request ID, doctor name, or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Master (racks & shelves)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organize storage by number of racks/shelves for quick access and updates, with customizable data (packaging, unit of measure, active substance, mover/driver, manufacturer). [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Stock report management
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Stock per batch with value and expiry; mark items that are running low/expired; monitor upcoming expiry; manage escrow with dispute settlement.
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Product & inventory management
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track inventory and expiry, record purchases/shipments, manage a unified general ledger, handle substitutes/variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Handover management
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Doctors can prescribe and hand over medicine, or take medicine directly from the pharmacy, all recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Shipment management
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track incoming and outgoing medicine shipments and fulfill them directly in the app.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock adjustments & reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record stock changes (lost, damaged, expired); keep audit history; manage returns to suppliers; download consumption, return, purchase, and handover reports for finance and requirements planning.
m.getting-started.title: Getting Started
m.getting-started.intro: The Getting Started guide introduces the purpose of the app and guides new users through the important steps for setting up a profile, exploring the main features, and navigating the platform effectively.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access & Workspace
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Sign in securely and access the work environment set for you.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation & Interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the home feed for updates, quick navigation shortcuts, and the bottom panel for core tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Pending Necropsy / Giving / Allocation
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals awaiting necropsy, administrative documentation, and subsequent allocation or destruction procedures before the record is finally closed.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Master Settings & Modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Configure master data, and explore modules such as Medical Record, Placement, Eggs, Feed, and Animal Management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personalization
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage notes, update your profile, and adjust language preferences.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Understand the access levels required for safe operations.
